title: The involvement of the human prefrontal cortex in the emergence of visual awareness (Fang et al., 2024): sEEG, 6 patients
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from six adult male patients with drug-resistant epilepsy performing a visual awareness task with saccadic report. Near-threshold Gabor gratings were presented while participants reported perception via saccade direction, allowing study of prefrontal cortex involvement in the emergence of visual awareness. The dataset includes per-trial behaviour, defaced T1 MRI, and source data with post-implantation CT and eye-position/behaviour files from patients and 10 healthy controls.
methods_description: Depth electrodes (SINOVATION, 8-20 contacts) were recorded with a NEURACLE amplifier at 1 kHz (1-250 Hz hardware filter, 50 Hz notch), referenced to a white-matter contact. Patients viewed a 50 ms Gabor grating at near-threshold contrast (staircase), plus supra-threshold and no-stimulus trials, then reported seen/not seen via a colour-cued saccade; eye position was recorded at 1 kHz with an infrared eye tracker. Original BDF data were converted to BrainVision format with exact digital values, and events were derived from trigger annotations and enriched with per-trial behaviour.
